crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.

translations.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
translations.bsb: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
translations.kjv: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
